intro.text: The JavaScript event loop decides what runs next.

stack.text: Calls push frames onto the stack. The newest call returns first.

async.text: The browser tracks the timer. When it expires, the callback enters the task queue.

queues.text: Promise callbacks run as microtasks. Timer callbacks run as tasks once the timer is ready.

loop.text: The script logs A and B. The promise logs C. The timer logs D.
